r.d:
This package provides an object oriented interface to GNU Privacy Guard (GnuPG). It requires the GnuPG executable to be on the system.
Though GnuPG can support symmetric-key cryptography, this package is intended only to facilitate public-key cryptography.
This package requires PHP version 5.2.1 or greater.
r.n:
This release fixes following bugs:
Fix Bug #21074: Crypt-gpg-pinentry fails on system without PEAR/Exception. Fix Bug #21075: Fatal error: Object of class Crypt_GPG_Key could not be converted. Fix Bug #21077: Increase Crypt_GPG_Engine::CHUNK_SIZE for better performance Fix Bug #21081: Performance bottleneck in pipes handling. Feature #21079: Added Crypt_GPG::exportPrivateKey() method.
